reviewSamples.author: Photo of Tim Evankovich
reviewSamples.text: We have used Sarai's cleaning for the past 4.5 years.  We love their service!  Gilma and her crew are efficient and extremely detailed oriented.  Always friendly and willing to go the extra mile.  I was in residential housecleaning for over 25 years so I know a good clean.  They are the best!!
